items.zh: 音乐领域正迎来软件变革。
items.en: Music culture was being revolutionized by software.

items.zh: 我正身处这样一个变革时刻。
items.en: I'm alive during one of these moments.

items.zh: 二人一生大多时候都在追寻新奇事物。
items.en: Both of them had spent much of their lives searching out novelty.

items.zh: 农忙季节，这个偏远的小村子显得空荡荡的。
items.en: During the busy farming season, the remote small village lies deserted.

items.zh: 上海博物馆的埃及展太火爆了，根本抢不到票。
items.en: The Egypt exhibition at the Shanghai Museum is so popular that it is virtually impossible to secure a ticket.
